text.box.ts: Builds the inline comment box: a text area under the code with the predefined texts as chips that insert into it, a Fix, Explain or Question radio group that a chip may suggest into but never over a choice the user made, saving on Ctrl or Cmd+Enter and cancelling on Escape
text.card.ts: Builds the compact comment card with its lines, a quiet label for the intent it has, text, edit and delete and a fold that keeps its state across repaints
text.controller.ts: Runs the inline comments of the review pane: which comment box is open, saving to the per-pull-request store with the chosen intent, the file and diff layers, focus after save or cancel, the jump to a listed comment, the remembered Copy all default intent and Copy all
text.float.ts: Shows the small Comment button next to the selected lines of the code or diff and comments on them from a click or Alt+Shift+C
text.gutter.ts: Moves one plus button to the hovered line number so a click, a drag over the lines or the arrow keys open a comment on a line or range
text.layer.ts: Puts the cards, the gutter marks, the range highlight and the box into a code or diff body and puts them back whenever the body repaints
text.layer.ts gotcha: Ignores its own elements by their lt-cm- class prefix when watching repaints, so new classes must keep it
text.note.ts: Builds the note that says how many comments are not in the current view and offers the other view
text.rows.ts: Reads the numbered rows of a code or diff body, maps a text selection to its first and last line and quotes lines, numbering diff rows by new-file line
text.tools.ts: Builds the review header controls: Comment on the file, the Comments count with its popover list grouped by file, and Copy all with the select for its default intent, its list popover mounted through the shared popover module
